en: Theragāthā 1.62 Ekakanipāta, Seventh Chapter I am alone, dwelling in solitude; My mind is well-composed and tranquil. Free from fear, I wander at ease; I have attained the state of peace.
The Verses of the Elder Vajjiputta:
like a discarded log in the woods.”
“Many envy me, as those bound for hell envy one going to heaven.
